name: NOAH
canonical: Noah, an exceedingly aged antediluvian patriarch of great years, weathered sun-browned skin deeply furrowed, a very long flowing white beard and long white hair, calm righteous deep-set eyes, broad work-hardened carpenter's hands, clad in a coarse undyed woven tunic and rough goat-hair mantle, a wooden adze or mallet at his belt and pitch-stained forearms from building the ark
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
